"%s" is an encrypted audio file. 
These typically are from an online music store. 
Tenacity cannot open this type of file due to the encryption. 
Try recording the file into Tenacity, or burn it to audio CD then 
extract the CD track to a supported audio format such as WAV or AIFF.

extrahera sedan CD-spåret till ett ljudformat som stöds, till exempel WAV eller AIFF.
